ND-2025-SB2370.aiSummary: North Dakota would require a legislative study on drug price reporting in the federal drug discount program. The study would look at which covered groups should report data, what data they should share, how the state could use it, and how to handle privacy and enforcement. It would also take input from hospitals, pharmacies, health centers, insurers, and state agencies, then report findings and any needed bill ideas to the next legislature.
